title: Repin the deployed Jenkins library and make a main krn/gate rerunnable by the lead
body:
Outcome: the deployed Jenkins library names the failing stage in every krn/gate failure, and a failed main krn/gate can be re-run by the lead without a new merge. Evidence: main 7b01635 krn/gate (attempt 1f057a44) used the pre-6bfdd3a summary 'failed or is unverified' with Primary 'hudson.AbortException: Error cloning remote repo origin' (test/deliver/fixtures/gate-no-stage.fixture), so the deployed library_sha predates 6bfdd3a; the lead Jenkins account krn-lead has Build on Product PR jobs only (.krn/runs/ci-platform/lead-access/recon.md), and the 127.0.0.1:18080 tunnel needs the PVE password from Bitwarden. Work: read the live library_sha, repin it to a main SHA containing 6bfdd3a with config_sha consistent (infra/ci/jenkins/diagnostics-and-queue.md), decide main Job/Build for krn-lead or a krn ci rerun --branch main path, and prove on the receiver.
Lead trap: deliver names a main krn/gate cause from the check output; main has no lead rerun, so the next merge to main runs the gate again; never re-push to rerun.
